A '''laser tip''',<ref name="SWS" /> also known as a '''lasing tip''',<ref name="XWRS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref> was a polarized alloy emitter from which [[Laser/Legends|laser]] burst were directed. They were mounted to [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and were generally fitted with [[Magnetic flashback suppressor/Legends|magnetic flashback suppressors]]. The tips deteriorated with each shot fired, and had to be replaced periodically; damaged or [[Carbon scoring/Legends|carbon-scored]] laser tips could cause dangerous flashbacks. Laser tips were found at the very end of the four laser cannons mounted on the wings of the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="SWS" /> A visual inspection of the laser cannon's barrels, flashback suppressors, [[Gate Coupling|gate couplers]] and laser tips was done prior to takeoff by every [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="XWRS" />
